text:
anya: Quick note from trying the telemetry sample app — JS SDK shipping in examples/telemetry-js isn't propagating x-request-id into OTEL spans and the console logs print raw prompts at INFO. Repro below.
devon: oh no. Which version of the SDK and sample app?
anya: SDK v0.9.2 from npm, cloned examples/telemetry-js, ran `NODE_ENV=dev REDACT_PROMPT=true node index.js`.
li: can you paste a log line?
anya: `INFO 2026-03-10T09:12:01Z request handled route=/chat prompt="What's the weather?" request_id= - client=telemetry-sample`
max: request_id shows hyphen. Means transport never generated/injected it. OTEL spans also missing `redwood.request_id`. This breaks trace->log correlation.
devon: we intentionally standardized on header `x-request-id` and span attribute `redwood.request_id`. Python middleware and go-sdk both set them at transport init. JS appears to have lost it in the fetch wrapper rewrite.
li: another issue: redact env var only toggles redaction for ERROR logs, see src/logger.js line ~120. Should redact at all levels when REDACT_PROMPT=true.
anya: I ran a quick grep to demonstrate: `node index.js | sed -n '1,200p' | grep -E "prompt=\""` returns raw prompts even with REDACT_PROMPT=true.
max: suggested quick fixes: 1) ensure transport emits `request_id` on the response object and that logger merges it into defaultMeta 2) update OTEL hook to read from transport context and set span attribute at span start 3) move redaction into a pre-format filter that rewrites message tokens when REDACT_PROMPT=true.
devon: example redaction filter snippet (pseudo):
```js
logger.addFilter(record => {
  if (process.env.REDACT_PROMPT === 'true') {
    record.message = record.message.replace(/prompt=\"[^\"]*\"/g, 'prompt=\"[REDACTED]\"')
  }
  return true
})
```
li: and OTEL attach example: `const span = api.trace.getSpan(context.active()); if (span) span.setAttribute('redwood.request_id', reqId)` right after you compute reqId.
anya: I also propose a tiny CI check: run the sample app in a container with REDACT_PROMPT=true and assert stdout contains no prompt regex. Could be a 1-liner in examples/telemetry-js/.github/workflows/ci.yml.
max: +1. Add unit tests in js-sdk logging tests: when REDACT_PROMPT=true and log level=DEBUG/INFO/WARN/ERROR the raw prompt must not appear. Regex assert is fine.
devon: opened issue #2691 and assigned to @anya and @li: "js-sdk: ensure request_id propagation to logs and OTEL; redact prompts at all levels in samples and SDK" (<https://redwood.internal/issue/2691>)
ci-bot: Created PR job: run-tests/telemetry-js for branch telemetry/redact-requestid by anya.
anya: I'll attach a minimal patch: transport sets `reqId` on context, logger defaultMeta picks it up, otel-hook reads from context and sets `redwood.request_id`. I'll include before/after logs in PR description. ETA tomorrow AM.
li: I'll help with tests and CI workflow. Also let's update docs/devex/telemetry.md to include a dedicated section on request-id conventions and the example filter snippet.
max: sounds good. One more: consider defaulting REDACT_PROMPT=false still, but document the risk and recommend enabling in prod by default in examples.
anya: agreed. I'll also add a brief note in examples/README and an example of a minimal grep-based e2e: `docker run --rm telemetry-example | grep -E "prompt=\"" && exit 1 || exit 0` as test.
devon: thanks all. Once PR is up ping me and I'll review quickly.
